references.text: Jacob and his family travel to Egypt, and Benjamin's sons are mentioned here as the ancestors of the tribe of Benjamin counted in Numbers.
The first census of the tribe of Benjamin at Sinai, where the number was 35,400, which can be compared with the figure 45,600 in this second count.
The tribe of Benjamin and their numbers are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement, showing the organization of the tribe.
Benjamin's genealogy in Chronicles provides further details about the descendants of the tribe and their numbers.
An extended family tree for Benjamin that supplements information about the tribe's families and descendants.
The birth of Benjamin is mentioned; he is the youngest son of Jacob and the ancestor of this tribe.
